messages.subject: no *.Rmd produced by spin()
parts:
I'm using spin() since one year now.It is a great tool.
I've realized that after running spin() the *.Rmd is produced but then deleted
and replaced by the corresponding *.md and *.html. I would like
to actually keep the *.Rmd to edit it sometimes. Have tried
spin("CBBiot_PCA_rcharts_log.R",precious=FALSE,format="Rmd")

but even in that case I get
output file: CBBiot_PCA_rcharts_log.md

What should I do to keep the *.Rmd file?
Thanks
Agus

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
